description: Production e-commerce platform with strong operational practices and reliability but needs cost and security improvements

recommendations.title: How do you securely operate your workload?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Implement AWS Security Hub and enable automated security checks across all accounts.

recommendations.title: How do you manage identities for people and machines?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Centralize identity management using AWS IAM Identity Center and enforce least-privilege access.

recommendations.title: How do you detect and investigate security events?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Enable AWS CloudTrail in all regions and configure Amazon GuardDuty for threat detection.

recommendations.title: How do you protect your data at rest?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Enable encryption at rest for all data stores using AWS KMS customer managed keys.

recommendations.title: How do you manage your usage to stay within budget?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Implement AWS Budgets with alerts and use Cost Explorer to identify optimization opportunities.

recommendations.title: How do you select the best pricing model?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Analyze usage patterns and purchase Savings Plans or Reserved Instances for steady-state workloads.

recommendations.title: How do you decommission resources that are no longer needed?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Implement automated resource lifecycle policies and regularly audit for unused resources.

recommendations.title: How do you select the best compute resources?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Benchmark workloads and right-size instances using AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.
